audit.whatIsWrong: Both charts disagreed with their own why-text and with the packet. Content had win[0] Gragas (whys[0] says neither side wins), win[3] and win[5] Skill (whys say you win every extended trade and that first item is your peak), and win[6] Gragas (whys[6] says 'She out-scales hard'). The full layer had level 1 as Gragas 8/10 and 2+ items as Gragas 8/10.
audit.why: packet.levelChart reads Skill, Gragas, Gragas, Gragas, Gragas, Gragas, Vayne, which matches the prose on both layers exactly. Win rate 53.64% over 604 games — a lane you win until she scales.
audit.corrected: Chart flipped as one atomic group on both layers to Skill / Gragas / Gragas / Gragas / Gragas / Gragas / Vayne, with ratings and the two contradicted why-strings rewritten.

audit.why: spikes[] already names the right four windows: level 2 (Q+W online), level 6 (E-W-Q-cask all-in), first item, and Vayne at two-plus items with Final Hour. The full-layer phases[6].why contradicted this and was corrected.
audit.corrected: phases[6].why now states the Silver Bolts true damage and Final Hour Tumble-invisibility spike that actually defines that stage.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer carried generic filler ('Wall-stun', 'his key tool', 'Your committal tool') with no numbers and male pronouns for Vayne. The decisive facts were absent: Condemn is 20s at rank 1, it is a knockback that stuns only on terrain collision and can cut Gragas's 1-second Drunken Rage sample; Tumble is 6s falling to 2s and is further reduced by Final Hour; Silver Bolts has no cooldown and deals percent-max-health true damage on every third hit.
audit.why: Riot text and cooldowns: Condemn 20/18/16/14/12, 'knocking them back... if they collide with terrain, they are impaled... stunning them'; Tumble 6/5/4/3/2, range 300; Silver Bolts cd 0, cost 0, true damage; Final Hour grants 'Invisibility during Tumble, reduced Tumble cooldown'. Gragas W 'samples his latest brew for 1 second'; Body Slam range 600, cd 14 at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Numbers and the terrain/knockback/sample-interrupt facts written into tradeGood, tradeBad, dosFull, dontsFull, breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].

audit.whatIsWrong: Trading rules never used the range gap: Body Slam reaches 600 and Barrel Roll 850, while Tumble only moves her 300.
audit.corrected: tradeGood now keys the commit to baiting Tumble and to Condemn's 20s.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns used placeholders instead of naming Condemn's 20s and Tumble's 6s-to-2s.
audit.why: Those two numbers are the whole engage decision.
